entity.summary: Open-source non-custodial mobile Web3 wallet for Polkadot, Kusama and supported networks.
entity.notes: Current first-party Nova documentation explicitly describes Nova Wallet as non-custodial on iOS and Android with private keys stored locally on the user's device. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Nova Wallet non-custodial mobile application for Polkadot, Kusama and supported Web3 networks on iOS and Android.
products.notes: Current first-party documentation explicitly establishes iOS/Android distribution and local private-key storage. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: Nova Wallet Android v10.8.0 released
events.description: Novasama published Nova Wallet Android v10.8.0 with scam-warning protections, watch-only EVM account support, additional swap routes, and bug fixes, documenting ongoing wallet maintenance in 2026.
